input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: The only renewing element is maintenance, which runs for "a renewable one-year term" (p0065) — a 12-month term that is renewable rather than automatically renewing, so renewal effectively requires the parties' agreement and there is no non-renewal notice window imposed on us and no multi-year auto-renewal. The licence itself is perpetual while fees are paid (p0117) and we may exit on 90 days' notice at any time (p0118). This meets the preferred position (renewal by agreement, 12-month term, no opt-out hurdle) and is well clear of the walk-away triggers. Two preferred sub-elements are absent but immaterial and not redlined: there is no Garman renewal reminder and no express cap on maintenance fee uplift on renewal (fees are simply "in accordance with the Fee Schedule"); if the Fee Schedule permits Garman to reset renewal fees, we would ask commercially for a CPI/3% cap. We would also be content to clarify "renewable" as "renewable by mutual written agreement" as a drafting nit only.
